approval: This extension changes source/control code. The old approval of PR62 head9fc cannot cover these new bytes. Require fresh independent human approval after full current-head/current-base hosted CI. The existing trusted reviewer workflow requests review only once qualification passes.

changes.apt_regression: Derive mirror expectations from the reviewed lock and independently test different distribution/security snapshot dates and their exact Release hashes.
changes.components: Select independently approved, protected-merged and immutably released discovery-bridge v0.1.8 and router-policy-agent v0.1.12. Both exact released sources select Go 1.27.4; qualified manifest and approval-history attestations were verified. Their data-only candidates were produced by the exact existing pinned proposer code running locally under checksum-verified Go 1.27.4. No hosted producer execution attestation is claimed.
changes.debian_inputs: Use November 11 06:00 UTC frozen snapshots, independently verify native signatures and complete index hashes. Retain exact signed metadata and content-addressed transport hints. The security index contains fixed zlib 1:1.3.dfsg+really1.3.1-1+deb13u1 and kernel 6.12.116-1.
changes.go_inputs: Use verified stable Go 1.27.4 and previous branch 1.26.11 with exact official native image digests to fix GO-2026-6859.
changes.go_scan: Validate the proposed stable patch and current matching advisory evidence before selecting it. Use exact GOTOOLCHAIN without +auto, official proxy and checksum database. Require go env GOVERSION to equal the selected SDK before the mandatory source scanner executes. Preserve the local-toolchain environment for module resolution.

failures.cause: Frozen November 3 Debian security snapshot predates the fixed zlib package; three installed-source vulnerability findings stopped the native image phase.
test_stage_identity_covers_patch_binaries_script_and_lock_version asserted a literal November 3 snapshot URL, rejecting legitimate November 11 snapshot updates.
The proposer changed .go-version to the authenticated security patch but the final mandatory source scan used its old local Go compiler, so reachable GO-2026-6859 prevented publication of the fix.

remaining_rollout: After protected platform merge and qualified immutable release, update component shared maintenance workflow pins to that verified release through separately qualified source/control PRs so future compiler security fixes use the repaired helper. Reconcile PR59 against the merged fixes and close it only if every candidate change is already superseded; preserve any later independent update.

validation.debian: All four updated InRelease signatures and compressed/expanded index hashes verified against the frozen Release pins and the keyring from the pinned official builder.
validation.full_hosted_qualification: Pending after publication; no local probe certifies complete Alloy/Beyla or native image.
validation.go_inputs: Official stable release metadata, advisory evidence and native image digests independently verified.
validation.native_fixed_package: In a network-isolated pinned trixie container, native APT verified the frozen metadata and dpkg installed the fixed zlib payload whose SHA-256 was checked against the PGP-authenticated package index. Direct local-container HTTPS package fetching failed certificate verification; host HTTPS supplied the already-authenticated payload for this probe. No TLS bypass was used. Full hosted fetching and native qualification remain required.
validation.real_go_regression: Actual old-compiler scan reproduces reachable GO-2026-6859; actual repaired helper selects exact Go 1.27.4, authenticates live advisory evidence and scans the same component source clean.
